docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $225.00 FILED BY OSKOUEI, HOSEIN AS TO DEFENDANT DANRIDGE PLUMBING ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR APR-17-1995 AT 07:00 PM IN DEPT C

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF OSKOUEI, HOSEIN IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT DANRIDGE PLUMBING JUDGMENT SPECIFICALLY REFLECTS PLTF'S FAILURE TO PROVE PAYMENT FOR HOOK-UP WORK STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
